rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a metal can or tin used as a container.

example.english: This tin of dace with black beans has never been opened.
example.jyutping: ni1 gun3 dau6 si6 ling4 jyu2 mei6 hoi1 gwo3

rows.note: Use this for the chemical element itself, rather than for an object made from tin.

example.traditional: 錫係一種銀白色嘅金屬。
example.jyutping: sik1 hai6 jat1 zung2 ngan4 baak6 sik1 ge3 gam1 suk6

rows.note: Use this for a metal baking or roasting pan, especially one used in an oven.

example.english: I used a tin baking pan to bake the chicken wings until golden.
example.traditional: 我用焗盤焗雞翼，焗到金黃色。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 guk6 pun4 guk6 gai1 jik6 guk6 dou3 gam1 wong4 sik1

rows.note: Use this technical material term for tinplate or steel sheet coated with tin, not for an ordinary metal sheet.

example.english: Tinplate is steel sheet coated with tin.
example.traditional: 馬口鐵係喺鋼板表面鍍錫。
example.jyutping: maa5 hau2 tit3 hai6 hai2 gong1 baan2 biu2 min6 dou6 sik1
